description: Recent failed health inspections in a city, NYC borough or ZIP code over the last N days up to the newest published inspection: New York City Health Department closures and scores of 28 points or more (C range), Chicago inspections with the result Fail, Austin scores under 70, Boston failed inspections and closures. Newest first, with each establishment's id.

city.description: New York City (or Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, Bronx, Staten Island), Chicago, Austin or Boston (or a Boston neighborhood).

days.description: Window in days, ending at the newest published inspection. Default 30.

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code in a covered city.

name: restaurant_inspection_failures
title: Recent failed restaurant inspections and closures
